notes: C6-e (measure only, unchanged) now reads 6 vertices up to 2.8 mm below the head ring with its 1 cm grid that keeps the highest table triangle per cell. Under the deepest of them (x -0.025, z -0.6815) the exact ring top is 0.9470 m and the skin 0.9476 m (+0.6 mm); the highest ring top within that cell is 0.9515 m. A coarse-grid artefact on a sloped support (scripts/c6echeck.mjs); restSupport and the G1-d independent check read the drawn triangles exactly. Its other numbers: patient back 0.5 mm over the back pad, table top at 0.8475 m, pad tops 0.900 m.

Heels: the leg pads end at z 0.885 m and the heels at z 0.953 m, over the deck end with no pad. They are checked against the leg-pad plane (as the design 13 section 1 F27 numbers were). Floated heels are common practice (pressure-injury prevention); a heel pad would be a table change. Owner and clinician item (DN5).

WebKit: every first-attempt failure was a ready timeout at boot or a "WebGL: context lost." console error (U21) and passed on retry; Q1-c timed out once (the known second loss after a restore). Shared-process boot probes (probe/webkit-boot-probes.json): every 4th load of a process loses its context for the base and the G2 tree alike.
perf: compared with G1 verify round 2 on this machine (not a same-session base run); M8/M9 are deterministic counts per view, frame rates within run-to-run noise (V1 active 108.2 -> 105.9 fps).

The wrist glove depth at a workstation grab (C3-9b) rose from 5.1 mm to 8.8 mm (gate 10 mm): the fixed station grip closes its fingers on a wrist that now lies lower and rolled to neutral. The G3 finger-curl solve replaces that grip.
